timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,300–1,370 KRW/USD

WHY: Multiple sources indicate the won is strengthening ("살아나는 원화" / "the won is recovering") and the dollar is weakening ("주춤하는 달러" / "the dollar is stalling"). One analyst specifically expects the rate to fall to around 1,370 KRW/USD, meaning fewer won needed per dollar—a favorable environment for your monthly conversion.

TIP: Since the won is currently strong, locking in your $2,000 conversion now captures a relatively favorable rate; if the trend continues downward, waiting risks needing even more KRW per dollar later.
